notes: 3 billion JUP was burned on 2025-01-26, split equally between the team and community allocations (1.5 billion each), reducing the max supply from 10 billion to 7 billion.

A further 136,761,146.18 JUP has been burned across two programs: the Litterbox burn of 134,549,950.92 (2025-11-25), and VRFD fee burns totalling 2,211,195.26 (191,099.76 on 2025-09-03, 473,210 on 2025-11-25, and 1,546,885.50 on 2026-04-24). Jupiter's reported total supply is 6,863,238,853.82 JUP. These burns are not modeled as events, so supply figures here run ~136.76M higher.

The Net-Zero proposal passed by DAO vote in February 2026, taking JUP net emissions to effectively zero: Jupuary postponed with the tokens returned to the Community Cold Multisig pending a future DAO vote, Team Reserve emissions paused indefinitely, and Mercurial Stakeholders vesting accelerated.

Allocations with no scheduled unlock are held as TBD sections, tokens remaining in protocol custody: Team (~427.78M, paused), Mercurial Stakeholders (~82.45M), and Jupuary (1.4B — 700M postponed from 2026, 700M reserve with no airdrops planned).
Community Reserves (300M) and Strategic Reserve (1,332.7M) have no defined unlock schedule and are marked as TBD.

Active Staking Rewards (ASR) continues at 50M JUP per quarter to stakers. It is not modeled as a separate emission event: it is distributed from LFG Launchpad fees and previously unclaimed Jupuary and does not create new emissions. Non-JUP ASR payouts (ZEUS, UPT, SHARK, WEN, CLOUD, DBR) are outside this adapter.

Jupuary (Postponed).methodology: 1.4B JUP of Jupuary allocations remains unemitted following the Net-Zero proposal: 700M postponed from Jupuary 2026 and returned to the Community Cold Multisig, plus a 700M reserve with no further airdrops planned. Neither can be moved without a DAO vote. Jupuary 2024 (1B) and Jupuary 2025 (700M) were released.

jupuary-2026-postponed.name: Jupuary 2026 (Postponed)
jupuary-2026-postponed.methodology: 700,000,000 JUP scheduled for Jupuary 2026, postponed indefinitely and returned to the Community Cold Multisig. The usage and stake snapshot is preserved; release requires a further DAO vote.

jupuary-reserve.name: Jupuary Reserve
jupuary-reserve.methodology: 700,000,000 JUP allocated under Jupuary with no scheduled unlock. No airdrops are planned beyond the postponed Jupuary 2026.

Team (Paused).methodology: ~427.78M JUP of the 1.4B Team allocation paused indefinitely by the Net-Zero proposal. Tokens are not emitted from the Team Reserve; team members instead receive a credit against Jupiter's balance sheet, which buys their allocation directly if they wish to sell.

team-paused.name: Team (Paused)
team-paused.methodology: Paused portion of the 1.4B Team allocation: 427,777,777.73 JUP. The Net-Zero proposal paused Team Reserve emissions indefinitely, leaving 972,222,222.27 JUP released.

Mercurial Stakeholders (Undistributed).methodology: 82,448,107.97 JUP of the 350M Mercurial Stakeholders allocation has no scheduled distribution. Vesting was accelerated under the Net-Zero proposal with a single 77,968,558.70 JUP unlock on 2026-02-25, bringing the total released to 267,551,892.03 JUP.

mercurial-undistributed.name: Mercurial Stakeholders (Undistributed)
mercurial-undistributed.methodology: Undistributed portion of the 350M Mercurial Stakeholders allocation: 350,000,000 - 267,551,892.03 = 82,448,107.97 JUP. No scheduled distribution.
